definitions.gloss: flexible in thinking; open-minded; quick to adapt
definitions.explanation: Said of someone who can drop a fixed assumption and take up a new idea or method. It praises mental flexibility rather than intelligence as such.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}い⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{頭|あたま}が{柔|やわ}らかい。
examples.english: Young people are flexible in their thinking.

examples.japanese: {頭|あたま}が{柔|やわ}らかい⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ほど⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{道具|どうぐ}→道具：01479_dougu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦{使|つか}いこなす→使いこなす：07179_tsukaikonasu⟧。
examples.english: The more open-minded someone is, the faster they master a new tool.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{年配|ねんぱい}→年配：10432_nenpai⟧だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{頭|あたま}が{柔|やわ}らかく、⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{提案|ていあん}→提案：03536_teian⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{受|う}け{入|い}れて→受け入れる：05755_ukeireru⟧⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: The department head is older but open-minded, and often takes up suggestions from the front line.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a compliment, most often about adapting to new methods, technology, or unfamiliar ways of thinking. The negated form {頭|あたま}が{柔|やわ}らかく⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ is rare — the opposite is normally expressed with ⟦{頭|あたま}が{固|かた}い→頭が固い：06893_atamagakatai⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{頭|あたま}を{柔|やわ}らかくする→頭を柔らかくする：25852_atamawoyawarakakusuru⟧: to loosen up one's thinking
- {頭|あたま}が{柔|やわ}らかいうち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: while one's mind is still flexible
- ⟦{発想|はっそう}→発想：04309_hassou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{柔|やわ}らかい→柔らかい：01096_yawarakai⟧: to have flexible ideas

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{頭|あたま}が{固|かた}い→頭が固い：06893_atamagakatai⟧: rigid, set in one's ways — the standard antonym, and much more frequent in speech than any negation of this phrase.
